correctness.rationale: The repaired theorem works with the simplicial suspension S⁰*A and explicitly handles empty and disconnected A. Even-side parity allows neither or both cuts; the two matching families give K₀ and Δ({e,f})*A. Internal endpoint edges give the exact intersection A and a coning vertex in K₀. Sending f to e gives a simplicial deformation retraction relative to K₀, reducing to a null attachment if A is geometrically nonempty. If A={∅}, the result is K₀ plus a disjoint point, precisely the wedge with S⁰. Thus the relative homology assertion holds as well. Each of the 45 K₆ matching-complex edges lies in exactly one of its 15 triangles. Collapsing them leaves a connected graph with 15 vertices and 30 edges: 16 circles. The punctured complexes give K₃,₃ up to homotopy, yielding four 2-spheres and the large join yielding 256 3-spheres. Independent face-polynomial multiplication gives (32,340,1476,2589,1404,234), χ=−251; A has 100 faces counting ∅. Replay is in the repaired RESULT.md and VERIFICATION.md. Read the frozen checker and verification without running uploads; mod-two ranks alone do not certify integral homotopy.

value.rationale: The result replaces perfect-matching topology across a natural even 2-edge separator with two smaller joins, while preserving the original zero-cross subcomplex on integral homology. It gives a tractable exact mixed-dimensional example rather than just Euler/Bettis, and covers degenerate pieces with the proper convention. The value lies in the graph-specific compositional test, not in the standard pushout theorem.
